title: I am quite the belle in my new tam.
html_source: A “tam” is a type of tartan hat popular in the British Isles and Ireland.

anchor.text: I am quite the belle in my new tam.
anchor.prefix:
ed, sopping another die of bread in the gravy and raising it to his mouth.

Dearest Papli

Thanks ever so much for the lovely birthday present. It suits me splendid. Everyone says
anchor.suffix: I got mummy's Iovely box of creams and am writing. They are lovely. I am getting on swimming in the photo business now. Mr Coghlan took one of me and Mrs. Will send when developed
